body: As @mastacheata pointed out, there is a note `TBD - Need to re-do case studies / applicability` in the [0x03-Using-ASVS.md](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/blob/2bdfdb9b216c3e96ad9e30da337be617282be0dd/4.0/en/0x03-Using-ASVS.md#applying-asvs-in-practice) file which should be resolved.

comments.body: Have reached out to the community here.

We are going to have to fix this on the wiki post release. We do not have any new case studies. I would suggest someone take the case studies from 3.0 and put them on the Wiki and that'll have to do for 4.0. We will come back and revisit this in 4.1.
I am researching the real world ASVS use cases/stories for my local chapter meeting talk. I will put some replies already got through the ML. Hope more will come:)

From Matthew Hackling (@mhackling)
Drive pen test scope and test cases.. drive security requirements for designs help Populate an ISO27034 organisational normative framework aka requirements library etc.

From: Dominique Righetto 
I heavily use it for code review and, as a complementaty checklist, when I perform web application vulnerability assessments missions.

From: Giovanni Cruz
In our last OWASP Latam Tour Bogotá 2019 we made a training totally based on ASVS, we create all the content with a vulnerable platform, to our training mainly assist developers, and we got a great feedback, because in some way we try to show them how to use it and what levels of security they might want to achieve based on some standard.

From: Matt Tesauro
OWASP Defectdojo has built in ASVS support https://www.defectdojo.org/

From: @FluxReiners
A few weeks after ASVS 4 release, RIPS added support for it
https://blog.ripstech.com/2019/rips-3.1-adds-teamcity-ldap-jsp-support/

From: Sebastien Gioria
For some customers, I derivate it to make it a mandatory requirements to perform secure design and coding.

From: Riotaro Okada
Case 1:
Recent years I have observed some banks in Japan included ASVS into
their RFP for security testing services, as their mandatory
requirement.
They wanted proposals which security vendors would fit appropriate ASVS levels.

Case 2:
A local software vendor in Japan sells SFA related packages received
customer criteria to check whether their products would fit ASVS, and
which levels the product aligned.  (It was a good start for the vendor
to introduce secure development and verifications into their teams ;-)

From: John Patrick Lita
I use this and integrate this in our CI/CD activity
